Charizard GX: separate Hidden Fates, stamped and promo copies

2026-11-05

Charizard GX is not one printing. The name appears on Hidden Fates, Shiny Vault, promotional and Burning Shadows records. Even a 9/68 search can lead to both a regular Hidden Fates card and a Battle Academy stamped copy. Confirm the product as well as the number before checking what your card is worth.

Selected English Charizard GX references

These Holofoil catalog samples were retrieved November 5, 2026. Each row retains the price date of its own record.

The last row is an older observation, not a November 5 quote. None of these samples specifies raw condition or slab grade. They are not offers, completed-sale records or guaranteed resale values. The table is not an all-time ranking of the most valuable Charizard cards.

Same number, different product

Look for the Battle Academy stamp when comparing the two 9/68 records. Leading zeroes in a catalog number do not establish a different physical card on their own; the product and stamp are the important distinction here.

The catalog also has jumbo promo cards with familiar SM numbers. Those oversized items are excluded. Code cards and sealed collections are not physical Charizard GX singles and are excluded as well. A search result that contains the words Charizard GX does not automatically belong in your card's valuation.

Check your copy in the app

Search for Charizard GX with the full number and set, or use the Pokemon card scanner. Review the suggested record and confirm the product, artwork, stamp, language and finish. Record raw condition honestly, or enter the company and grade already on a slab.

The card price checker shows available prices and history for the selected record. A missing price must not be replaced with the Shiny Vault value or with a different promo. Keep different holdings separate when adding them to your collection.

Charizard ex and VMAX are separate searches

Charizard GX is different from Charizard ex in 151, Mega Charizard X ex and Shining Fates Charizard VMAX SV107/SV122. Use the name suffix and full number to narrow the search. The Pokemon card value guides connect those printing references without treating all Charizard cards as one price.
